night_bed.if: I want to take my phone to bed at night
then: I charge my phone outside the bedroom.
I read a book for 10 minutes before bed.
I switch on sleep mode and turn off the light.
I go for a short walk.
I call a friend.
I start a task I chose in advance.
I breathe slowly for 2 minutes.
I take a shower or wash my face.
I write down what I'm feeling in one sentence.

boredom.if: I'm bored and start scrolling aimlessly
then: I put the phone down, get up and change rooms.
I do 10 minutes of movement.
I go back to an unfinished task.
I message someone I trust.
I go somewhere with people around.
I look at my value cards.
I open the urge-moment screen and breathe.
I do the 5-4-3-2-1 awareness exercise.
I take a short walk.
I gently tell myself what I'm feeling.
I put on music I love.
I talk to someone close to me.
I switch off the screen and go to bed early.
I drink a glass of water and rest.
I take a short shower.
I get out of bed and read a book in dim light.
I do a breathing exercise.
I leave my phone outside the room.

after_argument.if: I feel bad after an argument
then: I walk for 10 minutes to calm down.
I write down what I'm feeling.
I talk to a friend.

social_media.if: an urge comes while I'm scrolling social media
then: I close the app and put the phone down.
I move to another room straight away.
I open the SOS tool.

alcohol.if: an urge comes after drinking alcohol
then: I leave my phone in another room.
I stay with someone.
I drink some water and go to sleep.

waking.if: I linger in bed after waking up in the morning
then: I get up straight away and open the curtains.
I keep my phone away from the bed.
I start the day with a short stretch.
